name: Rummaging Millipede
subtitle: it's right in front of you, fool!
rules: COVERT -- When this card enters play, you may pick a tactic in your discard pile. If you do, put that tactic into your hand.
flavor: I should have sent the centipede.
notes: Card prints 'put that tactic into your hand'; catalog has 'put it into your hand'. Footer has www.thespoils.com in place of an artist credit.

name: Obsessive Compulsion
subtitle: a place for everything and everything in its place
rules: Look at the top 3 cards of your deck. You may put any number of those cards on the bottom of your deck in any order. Put the remaining cards on the top of your deck in any order. Draw a card.
notes: Footer has www.thespoils.com in place of an artist credit.

name: Recollection Bazaar
subtitle: "that time I ate too much pie" is always popular
rules: RECALL -- COST – Pick a resource you control. (You can pick face-down resources.) EFFECT – Put the resource into your hand.
notes: Card prints 'Put the resource into your hand'; catalog has "into it's owner's hand" (also a catalog typo 'it's'). Your hand vs owner's hand can change play for a resource you control but do not own. Footer has www.thespoils.com in place of an artist credit.

name: Quotidian Disappearance
subtitle: don't know where they go, but i hope they stay there
rules: Your opponent must pick a non-resource card they control. If they do, put that card into its owner's hand.
flavor: Political enemies of Amalforact often attract the unwanted attentions of the firm's public compliance officers, who do their job with perverted glee.
notes: Card prints 'Your opponent must pick ... put that card into'; catalog has 'An opponent picks ... if they can ... put it into'. Footer has www.thespoils.com in place of an artist credit.

name: Class Action Defender
subtitle: because corporate giants have rights too
rules: If any amount of damage greater than 4 would be inflicted to this card, inflict no damage instead. -- If you are attacked, you may pay 2. If you do, restore this card.
flavor: "Is that everyone? Okay, your refund is right down that alley..."
notes: Card prints 'If any amount of damage greater than 4 would be inflicted to this card, inflict no damage instead' and 'If you are attacked'; catalog has 'When ... is inflicted ... reduce it to 0' and 'When you are attacked'. Footer has www.thespoils.com in place of an artist credit.
